preconditions.description: The number of main courses k is between 1 and n, and n is between 1 and 100,000.
The list of main courses has exactly k elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= course <= n for course in main_courses)
preconditions.description: Each main course number is between 1 and n.
The list of dependencies has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= n - 1 for t_i, _ in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each course has between 0 and n-1 dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= dep <= n for dep in deps) for _, deps in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each dependency is a course number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(deps) == t_i for (t_i, deps) in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each list of dependencies has exactly t_i elements.
The total number of dependencies does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a list of course numbers starting with the count of courses.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= int(course) <= n for course in return_value.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', each course number in the list is between 1 and n.
If the output is not '-1', all course numbers in the list are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(course) in main_courses for course in return_value.split()[1:] if int(course) in main_courses)
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', all main courses are included in the list of courses to be taken.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(course) not in visited for course in return_value.split()[1:] if (visited := set()) or (visited.add(int(course)) or False) for dep in dependencies[int(course) - 1][1] if int(course) in return_value.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', there are no cycles in the course dependencies.
